protocol.name: junban-phase1-hosted-server-v1
notes: Optimized release junban-server + production dist only; fail closed on protocol violations.
Quick mode exercises the harness but cannot provide authoritative evidence.
protocol.regression_rule: a per-phase warm-median increase above the larger of 20% or 2 MiB requires measured explanation and explicit acceptance; final 24/32 MiB ceilings cannot be waived
protocol.task_count_justification: 100 ordinary creates warm SQLite/list paths without Phase 2's 10_000-task fixture.
protocol.token: deterministic per sample, pre-written owner-only access-token
protocol.variance_rule: same-commit warm median must remain within the larger of 15% or 1 MiB; otherwise repeat on an idle host and retain both reports
